meta.description: Power plants located in China from the World Resources Institute Global Power Plant Database (v1.3.0). Each record includes plant name, unique GPPD identifier, capacity in MW, coordinates, primary and any secondary fuels, commissioning year, owner, data source, and reported / estimated annual generation (GWh) for 2013–2019 where available. Contains 4235 records. Download in Excel, CSV, PDF formats.
